policy: Only verified live guides, approved assets and verified destination accounts. Never publish posts with fake product photos, invented prices or reviews.
notes: Calendar entries are ideas, not scheduled Metricool posts.

TikTok account remains lakelecco; do not schedule until rebrand confirmed.
Check Pinterest board before any Pinterest pin.
Cross-posting to Facebook/Pinterest requires verified profiles and media.
